title: Rippling pricing - $8-$35/employee/month plus a mandatory base platform fee
clean_text: Rippling's base Unity platform starts at $8/employee/month plus a mandatory $35-$40/month flat platform fee; most companies end up paying $20-$35/employee/month once they add the modules they need. Common configurations are roughly $15/employee/month for HR+Payroll, $22 for HR+Payroll+Benefits, and $35 for a full enterprise stack. Based on 273 verified purchases, the median annual contract is $39,720-$45,645/year (range $5,450-$164,907), with buyers saving 15% on average versus list. Implementation fees add $1,000-$5,000 in year one, and renewals carry a 5-7% annual price escalation.

meta.pricing_model: modular subscription, per-employee per-module plus base platform fee
